description: This PHP source file defines the Goteo\Controller\Review class, which manages review-related actions such as viewing activity, reviews, history, and handling review states within the Goteo project. It includes methods for displaying user reviews, managing review states, and generating navigation menus.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Controller class managing review workflows, including activity overview, review management, and history within the Goteo platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the user's review activity page with assigned reviews.

methods.name: activity
methods.description: Shows a summary of projects assigned for review, with options for different views.

methods.name: reviews
methods.description: Manages individual review actions such as marking as complete, selecting, or opening reviews, and displays review details.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the user's review history, with options for detailed view.

methods.name: menu
methods.description: Generates the navigation menu structure for review sections.
